slots.notes: Fullscreen muted autoplay hero background video, absolute object-cover filling the min-h-screen black container behind all foreground UI. Shifted down 17% (translate-y-[17%]) so the top is cropped and the lower portion of the frame reads as the focal content. Loop is driven by a custom JS requestAnimationFrame opacity fade (500ms fade-in on load/loop, 500ms fade-out at 0.55s remaining) rather than the native loop attribute, so the source should tolerate a hard currentTime=0 reset and read cleanly at full and zero opacity.
Display serif for the H1 headline only, applied via inline fontFamily. Native value is Google Font 'Instrument Serif' (regular + italic). Loaded via CSS @import; needs a serif fallback.

mechanic: A single full-screen flex-column hero (liquid-glass nav, centered Instrument Serif headline with a glass email-capture bar and manifesto button, and a glass social-icon footer) layered over a fullscreen object-cover background video that loops via a custom requestAnimationFrame opacity fade in/out.
techDelivery: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript single component, Tailwind CSS 3 (default config, no extensions), lucide-react for all icons; Instrument Serif via CSS @import, liquid-glass effect as a hand-authored .liquid-glass class, video loop fade driven by useRef + useEffect + requestAnimationFrame.
reskinNotes: The signature .liquid-glass class bakes white rgba values into the surface (rgba(255,255,255,0.01) + luminosity blend), the inset highlight (inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), and especially the ::before rim gradient (linear-gradient with rgba(255,255,255,0.45/0.15/0) stops + a -webkit-mask-composite:xor border-only mask), so every glass element assumes a light rim over a dark video and retinting requires editing that CSS rather than a token. fgMuted is expressed as Tailwind opacity utilities (text-white/80, placeholder:text-white/40) rather than a single hex, so muting varies per element. The background video's 17% downward crop (translate-y-[17%]) and the hero's -translate-y-[20%] vertical offset are framing magic numbers tuned to this video and viewport. The headline is whitespace-nowrap and font-metric-dependent on Instrument Serif (tracking-tight), so a longer headline or a substitute display font can overflow or rewrap. All copy (logo 'Asme'; nav 'Features'/'Pricing'/'About'; 'Sign Up'/'Login'; headline 'Built for the curious'; email placeholder; the subscribe subtitle; the manifesto button) and the Instagram/Twitter/Globe icon choices plus their aria-labels are hardcoded in JSX.
